title: Backup failed
symptom: After updating to AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-g (build 1da267f05c-2023.02.08), the app crashes and reboots when attempting maintenance/export setup. Users report inability to export settings to JSON, with AAPS either crashing/restarting or stating it lacks write permissions despite having them.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but a user notes that the newest version only has rights for media files, while the previous version had rights for all files, suggesting a permission regression.
fix: The maintainer reverted the change, implying the fix is to revert to a previous version or wait for a corrected release. No specific workaround is given.
